contract.purpose: Roll shipment detail/root-container status into the header and linked load.

ordered_branches.explanation: Unbounded loop condition rowsUpdated=0. Usually derives minimum detail status1 and maximum helper-leading status, subject to a container-existence branch, then extends range with root containers (PARENT NULL). Highest per-line quantity at997 can override minimum via configured action status, capped by maximum. Invalid/nonpositive/NULL statuses and minimum>=994 invoke configured defaults selected by old leading>=300 or minimum997. Change flag is sticky across retries. On change, inserts active forward-progress alert requests before header update with NOLOCK NOT EXISTS; SCOPE_IDENTITY captures only one ID even if multiple alerts insert, so retry correction changes only that row. Header compares both old statuses, then updates both status dates to warehouse-local date, resets failure flags and stamps UTC. NULL old status or concurrent changes can prevent match indefinitely. On changed completion, refreshes positive linked load. No bounded retry/atomic transaction.

program.text: IF (NOT EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM SHIPPING_CONTAINER SC WHERE INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @iIntShipNum AND STATUS >= 700 AND CONTAINER_TYPE <> N'<literal:1>'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM SHIPPING_CONTAINER WHERE INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @iIntShipNum AND PARENT = SC.INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM AND CONTAINER_TYPE=N'<literal:2>'))
OR EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM SHIPPING_CONTAINER WHERE INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @iIntShipNum AND INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_LINE_NUM IS NOT NULL))
SELECT  @minStatus = CASE WHEN (MIN(SC.STATUS) < @minStatus OR @minStatus IS NULL)
STATUS1, STATUS2, STATUS3, STATUS4, STATUS5, STATUS6, STATUS7, STATUS8, STATUS9, STATUS10,
QUANTITY_AT_STS1, QUANTITY_AT_STS2, QUANTITY_AT_STS3, QUANTITY_AT_STS4, QUANTITY_AT_STS5, QUANTITY_AT_STS6, QUANTITY_AT_STS7, QUANTITY_AT_STS8, QUANTITY_AT_STS9, QUANTITY_AT_STS10) AS QAI
WHERE INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @iIntShipNum ORDER BY QAI DESC);

limitations: This is the retained 2026-09-29 replica capture, not a new database inspection. The .sql file is the complete captured sys.sql_modules.definition encoded as UTF-8, including original comments, literals and line endings; nothing is prepended or reformatted. Captured definition text is not a complete deployment script: permissions, SET options, session context and dependencies are separate. No routine was executed. Static references do not establish branch execution, current use or runtime table scans. Vendor-base versus customer customization ownership is not established by names or comments.
A captured source reference establishes a static relationship, not that a module ran, a branch was reached, or a table is currently active.

NO_CAPTURED_REFERENCE means none of the credited channels in this exact retained corpus identified the table. It does not establish that the table is unused, obsolete, a backup, safe to delete, or absent from external application SQL.
Dynamic SQL, runtime-selected identifiers, external callers, client-generated SQL, uncaptured jobs and historical/other database code can use tables without a resolvable reference here.

The bounded lexer recognizes named SQL relation/DML positions and local aliases/CTEs; it is not the SQL Server binder. Unqualified names assume a unique captured name, not verified caller/default-schema resolution. Unsupported or ambiguous syntax remains explicit.

Identifier tokens and string-contained names are separate non-credit observations. Column names and configuration text can match table names; neither proves an executed table access.
Foreign keys are structural relationships and never count as procedure/function usage. View paths are catalog/source paths; attached trigger paths are possibilities, not proof the event fired.
